summary.text: Tyrone Carter is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 1 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026, and his career has included work with the Wayne County Sheriff's Office and campus police.

paragraphs.text: Tyrone Carter was born in Detroit, Michigan, graduated from Southwestern High School, and earned a B.S. in management from Central Michigan University.

His career experience includes working as a consultant with TLC Management and Consulting, an executive lieutenant with the Wayne County Sheriff's Office, an assistant director of campus police with the Wayne County Community College District, and a community involvement specialist with Southwestern High School.
Ballotpedia lists his tenure in the Michigan House as beginning in 2019, and says he assumed office as the District 1 representative on January 1, 2023.
